note: Effect sockets: named points that ride a bone, so an effect lands on the same spot every frame whatever the animation does. spec = bone, to (a child bone the point moves toward, optional), t (0..1 along bone -> to), extra [x,y,z] in the BONE's own axes (metres, unscaled rig units). sole = the bottom of the foot (found from the rest pose). ground_mid = the floor point at the middle of the unit (the root). Per-fighter overrides go in 'fighters': {key: {socket: spec}}; set only what differs. 'ground' sockets sit on the floor under a bone. Turn the markers on with --sockets (match.tscn) to see and tune them.
